_description: Index of Gaussian splat captures associated with ALHFRS deployment sites. Binary files (.ply, .splat) are never stored in this repo — this file is the manifest only. Splats are hosted externally (SuperSplat, R2, or local path) and embedded via iframe.

splats.notes: Jared's own capture, made on site on 2024-11-01 — the same day as lfr-506, which carries the first-hand corroboration note. The URL was previously hardcoded in the Leaflet build's splat pane (map-embed.html) and existed nowhere else in the repo; recorded here 2026-08-17 on Jared's instruction. The site carries nine documented Walworth Rd deployments, so this capture is matched to all of them by covers_location_name, not just to lfr-506.
